name: 00-default-demo-swiggy-zomato
statusMessage: Done: Swiggy vs Zomato. 3 opportunities, 2 threats, 6 named issues. Open the Output tab for the battlecard.
verdict: Biggest risk: 35.9% of Swiggy's specific 1–2★ complaints are about delivery and fulfilment, vs 24.1% of Zomato's. Fix this before marketing against rivals.

Wrong items or wrong delivery location received
